attributes.board_name: Illinois Department of Financial and Professional Regulation (Clinical Psychologists Licensing and Disciplinary Board)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Approved sponsors: APA or affiliates; National Register of Health Service Psychologists; ASPPB; AMA or affiliates; Illinois Psychological Association or affiliates; accredited colleges/universities/state agencies; IDFPR-licensed psychology CE sponsors (license no. 268...). In person or remote (live or pre-recorded); graduate courses; teaching (max 10 h)
rules.new_licensee_rule: CE is not required for the first renewal of a license.
rules.audit_note: Yes/no CE certification at renewal; proof only for random audits, restoration or discipline.
rules.notes: CE must be completed in the 24 months before the license expiration date. Required: 3 h ethics, 3 h diversity (coded cultural_competency), plus a separate 1 h cultural competency training (since Jan 1, 2025), 1 h sexual harassment, 1 h implicit bias, 1 h dementia once every 3 renewal periods.
rules.legal_basis: 68 Ill. Adm. Code 1400.60; 68 Ill. Adm. Code 1130 Subpart E
